name: ddns-ipv64
description: This Docker container is a DDNS updater for Free DynDNS - ipv64.net. If the ipv4 address at the site is changed, the new ipv4 address is sent to ipv64.net as an A-Record.

variables.name: Polling frequency IP address
variables.description: Polling frequency of the current IP address

variables.name: Polling frequenz Domain
variables.description: Polling frequenz for the domain (dig DOMAIN_IPV64 A)

variables.name: Domain Key
variables.description: DOMAIN KEY: YOUR DOMAIN KEY or DynDNS update hash can be found at https://ipv64.net/dyndns.php

variables.name: Domain Präfix yes|no
variables.description: DOMAIN PRAEFIX YES: This means that the domain PRAEFIX is actively used

variables.name: Domain Präfix
variables.description: YOUR DOMAIN PRAEFIX (subdomain). Use only one prefix (e.g. ddns)

variables.name: IP check
variables.description: IP CHECK: The IP address of the domain is checked

variables.name: Shoutrrr URL
variables.description: SHOUTRRR URL: Your Shoutrrr URL as notification service e.g. ( gotify,discord,telegram,email)

variables.name: Shoutrrr URL Skip Test
variables.description: SHOUTRRR_SKIP_TEST: No test message is sent when the container is started

variables.name: Name Server
variables.description: NAME_SERVER: : The name server to check the IP address of your domain
